description: This Java class 'AuthController' defines REST API endpoints for user authentication, specifically signup and login, as part of a Spring Boot application. It interacts with an 'AuthService' to perform the actual authentication logic, and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: REST controller providing authentication endpoints for user signup and login.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to register a new user with provided credentials.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to authenticate a user with provided credentials.
